name: flight_identifier
description: The alphanumeric code assigned by an airline to a scheduled flight (e.g., CA123).

name: departure_airport_icao
description: The ICAO code for the airport where the flight originates (e.g., KJFK).

name: arrival_airport_icao
description: The ICAO code for the airport where the flight concludes (e.g., LSZH).

name: aircraft_type
description: The ICAO code for the aircraft type (e.g., A35K).

name: aircraft_registration
description: The unique registration identifier of the aircraft (tail number, e.g., B-LPP).

name: origin_date
description: The date on which the flight is scheduled to begin.

name: departure_planned_at
description: The planned date and time of departure.

name: arrival_planned_at
description: The planned date and time of arrival.

name: last_updated_at
description: The timestamp indicating when the flight plan was last modified.

name: total_forcing_joules
description: The total expected effective energy forcing of the forecasted contrails impact in Joules.

name: flight_plan_json
description: The parsed flight plan stored as a JSON string.

name: bq_last_update_timestamp
description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated in BigQuery.
